"""Main's serialized sourceLLVM full phase-lease builds; no GPU execution."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-layer-major-phase4k-20261013')
T = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_full_build_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def dump(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    for name in ('main-layer-major-phase-full-build-root-v3', 'main-layer-major-phase-prefix16k-first-row-root-v1', 'main-layer-major-model-lifetime-root-v2', 'main-upstream-sync-skill-publication-root-v3',
                 'main-prefill-gated-region-12k-model-lifetime-root-v1', 'main-phase-gated-quality-publication-root-v3'):
        prior = json.loads((B / name / 'record.json').read_text())
        assert prior['passed'] and prior['complete'] and not prior['active'], name
        assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in (0, 1) for c in prior['commands']), name
    lint_tools = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
    if not (W / '.lint').exists():
        (W / '.lint').symlink_to(lint_tools, target_is_directory=True)
    assert (W / '.lint').resolve() == lint_tools.resolve()
    out = B / 'main-layer-major-phase4k-full-build-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    env = json.loads((B / 'main-native-copy-queue-build-root-v2/record.json').read_text())['environment']
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True,
             commands=[], evidence={}, environment=env, worktree=str(W),
             source_only_phase_implementation_reviewed=True,
             main_correction='Main reviewed source-only explicit4K geometry/admission/count/carve/reset and actual span guard; inherited full physical cache lease, checked failure lifetime, dtype and positive700 reserve unchanged. Adds source+checked-expert-copy host span diagnostic only',
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, production_admitted=False,
             phase_cache_adopted=False, sourceLLVM_compiler_sha256=m.sha(T / 'bin/clang++'))

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, wall=1200, cpu=20000, rss=24 << 30):
        print('OWNED BUILD/CHECK ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=wall, cpu=cpu,
                            rss_cap=rss, text_cap=16 << 20, total_cap=64 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], wall=30, cpu=60) == '8b48d17c99b70d32781f9f5b056602a598a37b1c'
        names = run('changed-source', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only'], wall=30, cpu=60).splitlines()
        names += run('new-source', ['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard'], wall=30, cpu=60).splitlines()
        assert names and all(name.startswith(('src/', 'include/', 'tests/', 'tools/', 'serve/', 'docs/'))
                             or name == 'CMakeLists.txt' for name in names)
        r['source_pins'] = {name: m.sha(W / name) for name in sorted(set(names))}
        assert len(r['source_pins']) == 18
        r['parent_revision'] = '8b48d17c99b70d32781f9f5b056602a598a37b1c'
        r['scope'] = 'Full sourceLLVM free/contrib-llvm and CPU ASan/UBSan; GPU/model/performance not executed'
        r['source_diff_sha256'] = None
        run('source-diff', ['git', 'diff', '--binary'], wall=30, cpu=60)
        r['source_diff_sha256'] = m.sha(out / 'commands' / 'source-diff.stdout') if (out / 'commands' / 'source-diff.stdout').exists() else None
        save()
        for mode in ('free', 'contrib-llvm'):
            folder = W / 'build' / mode
            # Reconfigure the same reviewed mode; only changed dependencies rebuild.
            configure = ['/usr/bin/cmake', '-S', str(W), '-B', str(folder), '-G', 'Ninja',
                '-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release', '-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=' + str(T / 'bin/clang++'),
                '-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=' + str(T / 'bin/clang'),
                '-DSTRATA_LICENSE=' + ('free' if mode == 'free' else 'contrib'),
                '-DSTRATA_ENABLE_XE=ON', '-DSTRATA_CUDA_ARCHS=', '-DSTRATA_HIP_ARCHS=',
                '-DSTRATA_ONEMKL=' + ('OFF' if mode == 'free' else 'ON'), '-DSTRATA_PORTABLE=OFF',
                '-DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON', '-DSTRATA_WERROR=ON', '-DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON',
                '-DSTRATA_GGML_DIR=/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/.worktree/dep-ggml-3cf-xe-e32-20261011']
            if mode == 'contrib-llvm':
                configure += ['-DSTRATA_ONEMATH_SOURCE=file:///home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012/build/contrib-llvm/_deps/strata_onemath-subbuild/strata_onemath-populate-prefix/src/xestrata-3.tar.gz',
                              '-DMKL_ROOT=/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1']
            run('configure-' + mode, configure, wall=300, cpu=1800, rss=6 << 30)
            run('build-' + mode, ['/usr/bin/cmake', '--build', str(folder), '--parallel', '4',
                                  '--target', 'strata', 'phase_cache_owner_test', 'phase_cache_vmm_test'])
            run('host-ctest-' + mode, ['/usr/bin/ctest', '--test-dir', str(folder), '-R', '^phase_cache_owner_test$',
                                      '--output-on-failure'], wall=180, cpu=1200, rss=3 << 30)
            r[mode] = dict(binary_sha256=m.sha(folder / 'strata'),
                          vmm_fixture_sha256=m.sha(folder / 'phase_cache_vmm_test'),
                          host_fixture_sha256=m.sha(folder / 'phase_cache_owner_test'),
                          compile_commands_sha256=m.sha(folder / 'compile_commands.json'),
                          built=True, host_ctest_pass=True, gpu_vmm_executed=False)
            save()
        for name in ('phase-host', 'phase-host-asan'):
            folder = W / 'build' / name
            # Existing CPU build configuration is revalidated.
            configure = ['/usr/bin/cmake', '-S', str(W), '-B', str(folder), '-G', 'Ninja',
                '-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release', '-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=' + str(T / 'bin/clang++'),
                '-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=' + str(T / 'bin/clang'), '-DSTRATA_LICENSE=free',
                '-DSTRATA_ENABLE_XE=OFF', '-DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON', '-DSTRATA_CUDA_ARCHS=',
                '-DSTRATA_HIP_ARCHS=', '-DSTRATA_ONEMKL=OFF', '-DSTRATA_WERROR=ON',
                '-DSTRATA_PORTABLE=OFF', '-DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON',
                '-DSTRATA_GGML_DIR=/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/.worktree/dep-ggml-3cf-xe-e32-20261011']
            if name.endswith('asan'):
                configure += ['-DSTRATA_SANITIZE=address,undefined']
            run('configure-' + name, configure, wall=300, cpu=1800, rss=6 << 30)
            run('build-' + name, ['/usr/bin/cmake', '--build', str(folder), '--parallel', '2', '--target', 'phase_cache_owner_test'])
            saved_env = dict(env)
            if name.endswith('asan'):
                env.update(ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1', UBSAN_OPTIONS='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1')
            run('ctest-' + name, ['/usr/bin/ctest', '--test-dir', str(folder), '-R', '^phase_cache_owner_test$', '--output-on-failure', '-V'], wall=180, cpu=1200, rss=3 << 30)
            env.clear()
            env.update(saved_env)
            r[name] = dict(binary_sha256=m.sha(folder / 'phase_cache_owner_test'), host_ctest_pass=True, sanitizer='address,undefined' if name.endswith('asan') else None)
        run('server-phase-lifetime', [str(W / '.lint/venv/bin/python'), '-m', 'unittest', 'serve.test_server.PhaseExperimentLifetime', '-v'], wall=180, cpu=1200, rss=3 << 30)
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in r['source_pins'].items())
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, scope='Layer-major explicit4K phase capacity sourceLLVM free/contrib-llvm and CPU/ASan/UBSan qualification; actual4K tiny/model/capture/quality/256K/performance remain unqualified')
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({key: r.get(key) for key in ('passed', 'error', 'scope')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
